exposure: rheumatoid arthritis disease activity before pregnancy
rheumatoid arthritis disease activity during pregnancy
outcome: rheumatoid arthritis disease activity in the postpartum period (DAS28-CRP-3, SDAI, CDAI)
cohort: 27 patients with rheumatoid arthritis treated with tight control.
finding: SDAI and CDAI scores for rheumatoid arthritis disease activity before and during pregnancy significantly correlated with and were predictive of disease activity in the postpartum period.
